verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim; porque minha alma confia em ti, e eu me refugio sob a sombra de tuas asas, até que os meus problemas passem de mim.
verses.en_web: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. When he went in flight from Saul, in the hole of the rock.> Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me; for the hope of my soul is in you: I will keep myself safely under the shade of your wings, till these troubles are past.

verses.en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
verses.pt: Clamarei ao Deus Altíssimo; a Deus, que cumprirá sua obra em mim.
verses.en_web: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
verses.en_bbe: I will send up my cry to the Most High God; to God who does all things for me.

verses.en: He shall send from heaven, and save from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.pt: Ele enviará desde os céus e me livrará, humilhando ao que procura me demorar. (Selá)Deus enviará sua bondade e sua verdade.
verses.en_web: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
verses.en_bbe: He will send from heaven, and take me from the power of him whose desire is for my destruction. God will send out his mercy and his good faith.

verses.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.pt: Minha alma está no meio dos leões, estou deitado entre brasas ardentes, filhos de homens, cujos dentes são lanças e flechas, e a língua deles são espada afiada.
verses.en_web: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is among lions; I am stretched out among those who are on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.pt: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; esteja tua glória sobre toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
verses.en_bbe: O God, be lifted up higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.pt: Prepararam uma rede de armadilha para os meus passos, minha alma estava abatida; cavaram perante mim uma cova, porém eles mesmos caíram nela. (Selá)
verses.en_web: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: They have made ready a net for my steps; my soul is bent down; they have made a great hole before me, and have gone down into it themselves. (Selah.)

verses.en: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.pt: Firme está meu coração, ó Deus; meu coração está firme; eu cantarei, e louvarei com músicas.
verses.en_web: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs, and give praise.

verses.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.pt: Desperta-te, ó glória minha! Desperta, lira e harpa; despertarei ao amanhecer.
verses.en_web: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.en_bbe: You are my glory; let the instruments of music be awake; I myself will be awake with the dawn.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.pt: Eu te louvarei entre os povos, Senhor; cantarei louvores a ti entre as nações.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make songs to you among the nations.

verses.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.pt: Pois tua bondade é grande, alcança até os céus; e a tua fidelidade até as nuvens mais altas.
verses.en_web: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
verses.en_bbe: For your mercy is great, stretching up to the heavens, and your righteousness goes up to the clouds.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.pt: Exalta-te sobre os céus, ó Deus; esteja tua glória sobre toda a terra. Salmo “Mictão” de Davi, para o regente, conforme “Altachete”:
verses.en_web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens, let your glory be over all the earth.
